name: Michael Ramos
office: East Whittier City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 3

items.text: Michael Ramos is a district sales representative for the California Lottery. He told the Los Angeles Daily News his top priorities are improving communication between the school board and the community, and budget oversight. He wants to ensure funds support students and staff, and prevent staffing cuts.
